title: Carousels
lead: A slideshow component for cycling through elements—images or slides of text—like a carousel.

prose.title: Example
prose.text:
Carousels don’t automatically normalize slide dimensions. As such, you
may need to use additional utilities or custom styles to appropriately
size content. While carousels support previous/next controls and
indicators, they’re not explicitly required. Add and customize as you
see fit.

prose.title: Controlled
prose.text:
You can also _control_ the Carousel state, via the
`activeIndex` prop and `onSelect` handler.

prose.title: Crossfade
prose.text: Add the `fade` prop to your carousel to animate slides with a fade transition instead of a slide.

prose.title: No transition animation
prose.text: Set the `slide` prop to false to disable the transition animation between slides.

prose.title: Individual Item Intervals
prose.text:
You can specify individual intervals for each carousel item via the `interval`
prop.

prose.title: Dark variant
prose.text:
Add `variant="dark"` to the `Carousel` for darker controls, indicators, and captions.

:::caution Heads up!

Dark variants for components were deprecated in Bootstrap v5.3.0 with the introduction
of color modes. Instead of adding `variant="dark"`, set `data-bs-theme="dark"` on the root
element, a parent wrapper, or the component itself.

:::
